_schema_note: season1/season2 are populated lazily by the Stats page. Each should match the shape of the live automarathon WebSocket state: { events: [ { name: <string>, stage: "QF"|"SF"|"GF" (for playoff/top8 matches) or omitted with name like "WEEK <n> RUNG <n>" / "WILDCARD MATCH" (for ladder-week matches), runner_state: { <runnerName>: { result: { SplitTimes: { splits: [ <36 entries, cumulative ms per split, or null if missing>, final_result: "<H:MM:SS>" or "DNF" } } } } } ] }. Until real split-time data is captured for a stage, leave the season value as null and the Stats page will show a not-available message.
